# translate each subgrid's color-2 shape so its bounding box center is nearest center of tile (2,2)
def center_block(b):
 pts=[(r,c) for r in range(5) for c in range(5) if b[r][c]==2]
 rmin=min(r for r,c in pts); rmax=max(r for r,c in pts); cmin=min(c for r,c in pts); cmax=max(c for r,c in pts)
 # target integer bbox midpoint if possible; for even spans use nearest center, preserving tie toward center
 dr=round(2-(rmin+rmax)/2); dc=round(2-(cmin+cmax)/2)
 # Python banker rounding ok if exact .5, choose translation toward center based midpoint sign
 if (rmin+rmax)/2==2.5: dr=-1
 if (rmin+rmax)/2==1.5: dr=1
 if (cmin+cmax)/2==2.5: dc=-1
 if (cmin+cmax)/2==1.5: dc=1
 nb=[[7]*5 for _ in range(5)]
 for r,c in pts:
  rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
  if 0<=rr<5 and 0<=cc<5: nb[rr][cc]=2
 return nb,(dr,dc)
centered=[(n,center_block(b),pos) for n,b,pos in blocks]
[(n,pos,off) for (n,(b,off),pos) in centered]
